name: web2app-electron
description: web2app for Windows — Electron 绿色版壳，与 webview-app（Tauri 版）行为兼容
author: Web2App

scripts.probe: pnpm run sidecar && pnpm run build && node scripts/launch.cjs --probe
scripts.pack: pnpm run sidecar && pnpm run build && pnpm run stage && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.dist: pnpm run sidecar && pnpm run build && pnpm run stage && electron-builder --win zip portable
scripts.dist:installer: pnpm run sidecar && pnpm run build && pnpm run stage && electron-builder --win nsis -c.extraMetadata.distribution=nsis --config.directories.output=../tests/pack
scripts.dist:all: pnpm run sidecar && pnpm run build && pnpm run stage && electron-builder --win zip portable && electron-builder --win nsis -c.extraMetadata.distribution=nsis --config.directories.output=../tests/pack
